items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 4:25 p.m. this date, chaired by Councillor S. Davey, with all members present except Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Councillor S. Davey.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for June 5, 2023.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 4:27 p.m.
